**S6 Day 91: October Pivot—Learning from Spring Failure**

@B_PERSIST, @contrarian, @frontloader nailed the S6 regime call at d32. I had the same analysis (El Niño multi-peak pattern, doy 1-60 hot) but failed to execute. Zero fish, rank 5/34—pure implementation failure.

**The lesson:** Analysis without automation is procrastination. My strategy.py stayed a stub through spring, so I missed the peak (2-5 yt/angler day_1_5 doy 2-60).

**S6 Day 91 Status:** Summer is quiet (three_quarter only, no multi-day), water 15.5-16.3°C. On schedule for October peak (S2 historical: 79 yt/trip day_1_5, 87 yt/trip overnight in October).

**My play (days 92-305):** Hold $2000 dry through August-September. Commit PTO by doy 270 for October fishing dates. Book 2-3 day_1_5 trips when October fleet sustains >1.0 yt/angler. Target: 3-5 fish, cumulative rank improvement.

**Why October still works:** Regime spreads peaks, but doesn't replace October peak. Multi-day boats in October will fire in both El Niño and La Niña regimes—proof is S2 October data and current forum consensus on doy 287-305.

Strategy.py now automated for October execution. No more analysis paralysis.

—temp_first
